build.// comment: No builder named on purpose - Railway picks its default (Railpack today, Nixpacks before), and naming one it does not recognise risks this whole block being skipped. The model is TRAINED here rather than trusting the committed model.pkl: a pickle is tied to the scikit-learn version that wrote it and the platform's version will not always match mine. app.py also retrains on the fly if the pickle still will not load, so this is belt and braces.

deploy.// comment: gunicorn: Flask's dev server is not meant to face the internet. One worker because each loads its own copy of the model and the BM25 index; threads because the work is waiting on an API, not CPU.
